name: Intro Only: Back to The City 🖤
description:
Let’s have a flirty night back in Madrid, shall we? 🍸
A few months ago, I invited all my single friends to a bar and told them to bring their single friends. We ended up with 40 people in one bar who all just happened to be single.
I made a video about it and you guys kinda went crazy over it.
A few dates came out of it, and two people that met that night are now fully boyfriend & girlfriend. So naturally, we have to do it again.
This September aka the BEST month in Madrid, I’m recreating the night, but this time opening it up beyond my close friends.
The concept is simple:
You + one single friend.
Each ticket admits two people. To keep the room curated and preserve the friends-of-friends feeling that made the first night so special, registration is approval-based.
I’ll just ask you to share your Instagram or LinkedIn so I can put a face to the name and make sure everyone joining is a real human. Your Instagram absolutely does not need to be public — a profile photo where I can see who you are is enough!
Come for drinks, make new friends, flirt a little, and see what happens 🖤
HOW IT WORKS
Request to join + share your Instagram or LinkedIn.

Once approved, you will receive your ticket for you & your +1.

Show up, meet new people, and have a fun night

Just friends bringing friends together in real life… who just so happen to be single.
***When you register, you will see a charge from Luma that is a "hold" charge. If I approve you to come the charge goes through, and if you don't get approved the charge is removed and you do not get charged***
The amount of girls to register has reached capacity, I'm waiting for more guys to register and I will then approve the final group!
Tickets do not come with a drink included. Drinks will be available for purchase at the bar :)
This event is exclusively for ages 20-40.

name: La Casa de ES LATINA en Madrid (Opening Party)
description:
Nômade Temple Madrid se convierte en la casa de ES LATINA hoy miércoles 16 de septiembre desde las 21:00h, repartido entre Monopol (sala de sonido inmersivo) y Say No More (el club del hotel).
En el cartel: Arca, Ralphie Choo, Aria Vega y Eduardo Castillo, un recorrido por la vanguardia electrónica y la nueva canción en español.
Este es el arranque de un mes de afterparties, actuaciones y live shows que convertirán al hotel en el punto de encuentro de ES LATINA en Madrid, el proyecto cultural comisariado por Shakira que del 18 de septiembre al 11 de octubre reunirá música, arte, moda, gastronomía y danza en una celebración de la cultura latina contemporánea inspirada en el realismo mágico.
Entrada libre por orden de llegada hasta completar aforo.

name: The Final Pitch: baby vc Madrid Meetup
description:
Tick-tock... The baby vc bootcamp applications are almost closing! ⏳ apply here
Join us on Thursday, September 17th, for an exclusive, laid-back evening with the baby vc Madrid organizers and alumni.
Whether you’re still polishing your application or you’ve already hit "submit", this is the perfect chance to connect with the local venture capital ecosystem over some cañas and good conversation.
Why should you join us?
Still finishing your application? Get your last-minute questions answered directly by people who have been through the bootcamp. Find out exactly what the 10-week fellowship is like and what we look for in candidates.

Already applied? Amazing! Come meet the team face-to-face and show us your passion for VC. We love seeing our applicants go the extra mile to engage with the community, consider this a great way to stand out!

Want to build your network? Meet like-minded peers who are also navigating their way into the venture capital world.

Just bring yourself and whatever questions are on your mind!
About baby vc: baby vc is a free 10-week fellowship designed to help driven individuals from all backgrounds break into venture capital.
Reminder: Applications for the upcoming bootcamp close September 21. Don't miss your chance!

name: Intro Only: Back to The City (For the Girls) 🩷🌈
description:
Okayyy girls, you asked and I listened 🍸
A few months ago, I invited all my single friends to a bar and told them to bring their single friends. We ended up with 40 people in one bar who all just happened to be single.
A few dates came out of it, and two people that met that night are now fully boyfriend & girlfriend (!!). So naturally, I decided we had to do it again.
When I announced the next one, the comments immediately became:
“okay but what about the gays???”
So I made one for the boys.
And then the girls were like… hello???
So here we are 🌸
Same concept, this time for women who date women.
Come solo or bring a single friend.
The idea is just to get a bunch of single girls in the same room, have some drinks, meet people you probably wouldn’t have met otherwise, flirt a little, and see what happens.
To keep the room curated and preserve the friends-of-friends feeling that made the original night so special, registration is approval-based.
I’ll ask you to share your Instagram or LinkedIn so I can put a face to the name and make sure everyone joining is a real human. Your Instagram absolutely does not need to be public — a profile photo where I can see who you are is enough!
HOW IT WORKS
Request to join + share your Instagram or LinkedIn.

Once approved, you’ll receive your ticket.

Show up, grab a drink, meet some new people, and have a fun night.

Just a fun night at a bar full of gay girls…who just so happen to be single🍸🖤
***When you register, you will see a charge from Luma that is a "hold" charge. If I approve you to come the charge goes through, and if you don't get approved the charge is removed and you do not get charged***
Drinks will be available for purchase at the bar and are not included with your ticket.
This event is for single women who date women, ages 20–38.

name: 🎈 F*ck the Small Talk: Madrid #5
description:
Sold out or can't make it? Drop us your email and we'll keep you in the loop for the next one! 😎
After traveling around the world from Berlin to London to Lisbon to Malta to Mexico City, we have finally arrived in Madrid! 🌞
📦 WHAT'S THIS ABOUT?
F*ck the Small Talk is an out-of-the-box social experience where strangers come together for an evening of meaningful, fun, and deep conversation. It’s also just a different & cool way of meeting new people by getting out of your comfort zone and skipping the small talk!
Join us for games, talks, and connections with friends you haven’t met yet. Join if you get annoyed after being asked what you do, where you are from, and how long you have been in Madrid every single time you meet someone. If you feel that there are better questions in life then this is the place for you. 🙌
📓 HOW DOES IT WORK?
We start with a short & sweet intro talk followed by a few light-hearted group games to warm up. After that, we split you up into small groups and start with the conversation rounds (with 3 people).
We'll have our own awesome question cards that will guide the flow of the conversation. (you’ll never have to speak in public if you don’t want) You'll be guided by an experienced host who'll make sure everything goes smoothly. 🍭 (introverts, you'll love it too ❤️)
🧧 WHAT'S INCLUDED?
⏰ 2.5 hours of facilitated and curated activities🍷1 drink (wine or non-alcoholic) + delicious tapas👥 A space to meet new people in the least boring way possible🙌🏽 Access to the post-event WhatsApp group💛 Supporting our mission to slowly eliminate small talk around the world🎫 Also includes those pesky ticket fees!
🕹 HOW TO JOIN?
Our events are limited to 30 guests to ensure a cozy atmosphere. (more than that is a party!) We prioritize a balance in gender and cultural diversity. Request to join above and we'll give you an answer in less than 48 hours!
📍 WHERE IS IT?
We host this events a beautiful private space in Salamanca. The exact location will be revealed once we confirm your spot! 🎟️
You'll be able to see the neighborhood at the bottom of this page. It is around metro Velazquez.
💛 WHAT THEY SAY
🗣 “This is the kind of activity humanity needs every weekend. Thank you for all.” - Sonya
🗣 “I loved F*ck the small talk, I was a little bit nervous at first but they are pros at making you feel comfortable with the rest of the group, the activities are really fun and I enjoyed every second (consider that the one who's saying this is very, very shy). Give it a try!” - Brenda
🗣 “Lively, interesting, introspective, completely open and no judgment. Everyone that joined was ready for great conversation and helped with different perspectives. So much fun! I can't wait for the next one! “ - Yaz
🗣 "it’s a wonderful experience, it’s like being a kid again, when you were at the park, playing with other kids, and just decided you were going to be best friends for the next hours. Maybe you’ll never see those kids again. But that hour was amazing because you both opened up and trusted each other." - Sara
Check out our 150+ Google reviews here 💙
👋 MEET YOUR HOST
Samantha has been teaching and facilitating events and programs across the globe in self-awareness, self-love, emotional intelligence, conscious leadership, and entrepreneurship. She loves dark chocolate, deep conversations, and dancing! 💃
🤓 QUESTIONS YOU MIGHT HAVE
‣ Can I come alone?Of course, in fact, we encourage it!
‣ Can I be late?Please don't. We start 15 min after the official start. Late arrivals tend to disrupt the flow of the event. Doors close 30 mins after the start time.
‣ Is this a dating or networking event?Not at all! No business cards, no awkward 1-minute speed rounds (ok maybe one)  - just real, meaningful conversations with some  friends you haven't met yet. (this doesn't mean crushes or business relationships can't happen, it's just not the intention 🙌)
